Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ANNEXURE-I SCOPE OF WORK Description of Job: Fabrication and installation of mounting fixtures/brackets and structural provisions inside the canopies of P ower Pack DG Set Engines, Emergency DG Set Engines, Fire Water Pump Engines and Mobile Compressor Engines for installation of Standalone Ceiling Mounted Automatic Fire Detection and Suppression System (AFDSS) at 06 (six) drilling rigs under Drilling Services, Tripura Asset, Agartala. The scope shall include site measurement, preparation/fabrication of suitable mounting fixtures/brackets, c

utting, grinding, welding, drilling, fitting, installation, alignment, strengthening wherever required and pain ting/touch-up of fabricated portions, complete in all respects, as per the instructions of DIC/Installation Ma nager or their authorized representative. The contractor shall ensure that the fabricated mounting arrangement is structurally sound, properly align ed, securely fixed and suitable for installation and safe operation of the AFDSS. The mounting arrangement shall not interfere with engine operation, maintenance activities, ventilation, exhaust system, electrical ca bles, fuel lines, piping or any other existing equipment/component inside the canopy. 1. Equipment-wise Scope The fabrication and installation work shall be carried out for the following equipment: Engines per No. of Rig Sl. No. Equipment Name Total Jobs Unit Rig s 1 Engine of Power Pack DG Set 4 6 24 AU 2 Engine of Emergency DG Set 1 3 3 AU 3 Engine of Fire Water Pump 1 6 6 AU 4 Engine of Mobile Compressor 1 6 6 AU 2. Power Pack DG Set Engine – AFDSS Mounting Provision For each Power Pack DG Set Engine, the contractor shall fabricate and install suitable mounting fixtures/br ackets for mounting of the Standalone Ceiling Mounted AFDSS. Indicative minimum materials per engine shall be: 1. Mounting Base Plate, size approximately 4" x 4" – 2 Nos. 2. Square Pipe, size 2" x 2" – 1 No. of approximately 10 ft length 3. 2" Clamp, size/configuration 3" x 2" x 10" – 3 Nos. 4. Suitable Bolts & Nuts – 20 Nos. The above quantities are indicative minimum requirements. Any additional minor material, fasteners, weld ing consumables, supports, gaskets, brackets etc. required for safe and complete execution of the job shal l be deemed included in the contractor's quoted rate. Total quantity: 24 AU. 3. Emergency DG Set Engine – AFDSS Mounting Provision For each Emergency DG Set Engine, the contractor shall fabricate and install suitable mounting fixtures/br ackets for mounting of the Standalone Ceiling Mounted AFDSS. Indicative minimum materials per engine shall be: 1. Mounting Base Plate, size approximately 4" x 4" – 2 Nos. 2. Square Pipe, size 2" x 2" – 1 No. of approximately 12 ft length 3. 2" Clamp, size/configuration 3" x 2" x 10" – 3 Nos. 4. Suitable Bolts & Nuts – 20 Nos. Total quantity: 3 AU. 4. Fire Water Pump Engine – AFDSS Mounting Provision For each Fire Water Pump Engine, the contractor shall fabricate and install suitable mounting fixtures/brac kets for mounting of the Standalone Ceiling Mounted AFDSS. Indicative minimum materials per engine shall be: 1. Mounting Base Plate, size approximately 4" x 4" – 2 Nos. 2. Square Pipe, size 2" x 2" – 1 No. of approximately 8 ft length

3. 2" Clamp, size/configuration 3" x 2" x 10" – 3 Nos. 4. Suitable Bolts & Nuts – 20 Nos. Total quantity: 6 AU. 5. Mobile Compressor Engine – AFDSS Mounting Provision For each Mobile Compressor Engine, the contractor shall fabricate and install suitable mounting fixtures/br ackets for mounting of the Standalone Ceiling Mounted AFDSS. Indicative minimum materials per engine shall be: 1. Mounting Base Plate, size approximately 4" x 4" – 3 Nos. 2. Square Pipe, size 2" x 2" – 2 Nos. of approximately 20 ft total length 3. 2" Clamp, size/configuration 3" x 2" x 10" – 4 Nos. 4. Suitable Bolts & Nuts – 20 Nos. Total quantity: 6 AU. 6. General Fabrication Requirements 6.1 The contractor shall visit each designated rig/site, wherever required, for taking actual measurements and assessing the existing canopy, engine arrangement and available space before commencing fabricatio n. 6.2 The mounting fixtures/brackets shall be fabricated to suit the actual site conditions and dimensions of t he respective engine canopy. 6.3 The contractor shall ensure that the mounting arrangement provides adequate rigidity and stability for safe installation of the AFDSS. 6.4 The mounting fixtures shall be positioned such that the AFDSS can be installed in the intended ceiling- mounted position without obstruction. 6.5 The mounting arrangement shall not obstruct or affect: engine operation; engine maintenance and inspection; canopy doors/access; ventilation and air circulation; exhaust arrangements; electrical wiring/cables; fuel/oil/lubrication lines; any other existing equipment or component. 6.6 Wherever required, suitable plates, stiffeners, additional supports, clamps or brackets shall be provide d to ensure structural stability. Such minor additional materials shall be deemed included in the quoted rat e. 6.7 Cutting, drilling, welding, grinding, fitting, alignment and installation of all fabricated members shall be carried out by the contractor. 6.8 Wherever bolted fixing is adopted, suitable high-quality bolts, nuts, washers and locking arrangements shall be provided. 6.9 Welding shall be carried out by qualified/skilled welders using suitable welding electrodes and proper welding practices. 6.10 No drilling, cutting or welding shall be carried out on any critical structural member, pressure-containi ng component, fuel tank, engine component or other sensitive equipment without prior approval of the DIC /authorized representative. 7. Installation and Alignment 7.1 The fabricated brackets/supports shall be securely installed at the designated location inside the canop y.

7.2 The contractor shall ensure proper level, alignment and orientation of the mounting arrangement so th at the AFDSS can subsequently be installed without requiring modification of the fabricated supports. 7.3 The final location of the mounting fixture shall be decided in consultation with the DIC/authorized repre sentative at site. 7.4 The contractor shall ensure that the mounting provision is capable of safely supporting the intended AF DSS unit and associated accessories, based on the actual AFDSS installation requirement communicated at site. 7.5 Any minor modification required during installation for proper fitment and alignment shall be carried o ut by the contractor without any additional cost. 8. Surface Preparation and Painting 8.1 All fabricated MS surfaces shall be cleaned properly after fabrication and installation. 8.2 Welding slag, rust, oil, grease and loose material shall be removed before painting. 8.3 The fabricated portions shall be provided with suitable anti-corrosive primer followed by two coats of synthetic enamel paint of suitable colour/shade matching the existing equipment/canopy, unless otherw ise instructed by ONGC. 8.4 Damaged paint surfaces of existing structures caused during fabrication shall be suitably repaired by t he contractor. 9. Cleaning and Housekeeping After completion of work, the contractor shall remove all scrap, unused materials, welding electrodes, met al pieces, grinding debris and other waste generated during the work from the rig site. The work area shall be handed over in a clean and safe condition to the satisfaction of the DIC/authorized r epresentative. 10. AFDSS Equipment The present scope is limited to fabrication and installation of mounting fixtures/brackets and asso ciated structural provisions for installation of the Standalone Ceiling Mounted AFDSS. However, the contractor shall ensure that the fabricated mounting arrangement is suitable for subsequent installation of the AFDSS. 11. Summary of Quantities Sl. N Equipment N Engines No. of Total Jobs Description of Job Unit o. ame per Rig Rigs in 6 rigs Fabrication and Installation of Engine of Powe 1 mount fixtures/ brackets for i 4 6 24 AU r Pack DG Set nstallation of AFDSS Fabrication and Installation of Engine of Emer 2 mount fixtures/ brackets for i 1 3 3 AU gency DG Set nstallation of AFDSS Fabrication and Installation of Engine of Fire 3 mount fixtures/ brackets for i 1 6 6 AU Water Pump nstallation of AFDSS Fabrication and Installation of Engine of Mobil 4 mount fixtures/ brackets for i 1 6 6 AU e Compressor nstallation of AFDSS

Transportation upto destination i.e. ONGC, Agartala is in the scope of contractor. 3. Inspection shall be done at destination i.e. ONGC, Agartala by Indenter for satisfactory completion of jo b. 4. Place of Inspection: At Site of ONGC Tripura Asset, Agartala 5. Correspondence address: Incharge FMP, Room no. 111, Drilling Services, Shed-1, ONGC Tripura Asset, Badharghat, West Tripura, Agartala- 799014. 6. Payment Terms: a) The payment against clear (undisputed) bills/invoices submitted by the vendor will be ma de by ONGC through Electronic Payment Mechanism (VIMS), within Ten (10) calendar days from the date of submission of bills/invoices complete in all respects after completion of Jo b. b) No advance payment in any form will be made by ONGC. c) Documents to be submitted along with invoice 1. Work Completion certificate 2. Warranty/ Guarantee Certificate d) Options for submission of Invoice and supporting documents are as under: 1. VIMS Portal (https://vims.ongc.co.in) : Documents to be digitally signed. 2. Email (ap_invoices@ongc.co.in): Documents to be digitally signed and Invoice atta ched separately and to be named with prefix “INV_”. 7. The fabrication and installation work shall be carried out at the designated drilling rig sites under Drilling Services, Tripura Asset, Agartala, covering a total of 06 (six) rigs. 8. The exact location of the rigs may vary within the operational area of Tripura Asset. The contracto r shall make all necessary arrangements for transportation of manpower, tools, tackles, equipment and materials to the respective rig sites. 9. The contractor may visit the concerned rig sites, with prior permission from the DIC/Installation M anager/authorized representative, for actual measurement, inspection of existing canopy and engi ne arrangement and assessment of the quantum of work before submission of quotation. 10. The bidder shall satisfy himself regarding the actual site conditions, accessibility, working space, dimensions, existing structures and other relevant conditions before quoting. 11. The dimensions and material quantities indicated in the Scope of Work are minimum/indicative re quirements. The contractor shall provide all minor additional materials and consumables required f or safe and complete execution of the work within the quoted unit rates. 12. All materials supplied by the contractor shall be new, unused, sound and free from defects and s hall be of reputed make and suitable quality.

13. The contractor shall be responsible for transportation of all materials, manpower, tools, tackles, welding machines, gas cutting equipment, grinding machines and other equipment required for ex ecution of the work. 14. All consumables required for the work, including welding electrodes, cutting gases, grinding whee ls, drill bits, primer, paint, thinner, brushes, fasteners, washers and other miscellaneous items, shal l be supplied by the contractor. 15. The contractor shall deploy suitably skilled and experienced fabricators, welders, fitters and helpe rs for execution of the work. 16. The contractor shall ensure that the work is carried out without causing damage to the engine, ca nopy, electrical systems, fuel system, piping, exhaust system or other existing equipment. 17. Any damage caused to existing ONGC equipment/property due to negligence or improper executi on by the contractor shall be rectified/ repaired by the contractor at his own cost to the satisfactio n of ONGC. 18. Hot work such as welding, gas cutting and grinding shall be undertaken only after obtaining the r equired work permit and following the applicable safety procedures of the rig/site. 19. The contractor shall comply with all safety instructions issued by ONGC and the concerned Install ation Manager. 20. The contractor shall provide all required PPEs to his personnel, including safety helmet, safety sh oes, hand gloves, safety goggles/face shield, safety belt/harness wherever required, cotton/FR wor k clothing and other PPEs as applicable. 21. The contractor shall provide suitable fire extinguishers/fire-fighting arrangements at the work loc ation during welding, gas cutting and other hot work, as required by site safety procedures. 22. Gas cylinders, welding machines, electrical tools and other equipment brought by the contractor shall be in safe working condition and shall comply with applicable safety requirements. 23. The contractor shall arrange boarding, lodging and transportation of his personnel, wherever requ ired. 24. No additional payment shall be made for transportation, mobilization, demobilization, shifting of t ools/materials between rigs or movement of manpower between the designated rig sites. 25. The contractor shall coordinate with the DIC/authorized representative before commencing work at each rig. 26. The work shall be carried out without disturbing the normal drilling/rig operations. The contractor shall follow the working schedule and restrictions imposed by the rig management. 27. The contractor shall maintain proper housekeeping throughout the execution of the work. 28. The contractor shall not remove any existing equipment, component or structural member witho ut prior approval of the DIC/authorized representative. 29. Any modification to the proposed mounting arrangement found necessary due to actual site cond itions shall be carried out by the contractor within the quoted unit rate, provided such modification is minor and directly related to the intended scope. 30. The contractor shall ensure that the completed mounting fixtures are rigid, properly supported, s ecurely fastened and suitable for the intended AFDSS installation. 31. The final acceptance of each completed unit shall be based on satisfactory inspection by the DIC/ authorized representative.

32. The contractor shall demonstrate the completed mounting arrangement to the DIC/authorized re presentative and rectify any deficiencies/defects pointed out during inspection at no additional cos t. 33. The contractor shall submit a work completion report, duly certified by the authorized representa tive of ONGC, for the completed work. 34. The contractor shall not claim additional payment for any minor item, consumable, fitting, fixture, fastener or activity that is reasonably required for completing the specified job, even if not individu ally mentioned in the material list. 35. ONGC reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity of work within the contractual provi sions depending upon site requirements. 36. No work shall be treated as completed merely on fabrication of the material. The unit shall be co nsidered complete only after fabrication, installation, alignment, painting/touch-up, cleani ng and satisfactory acceptance at site. 37. The contractor shall comply with all applicable labour laws, safety regulations and statutory requi rements applicable to the deployment of manpower at the rig sites. 38. The contractor shall obtain/maintain all permits, licenses, registrations and statutory compliances required for carrying out the work, wherever applicable. 39. The contractor shall be solely responsible for the safety of his personnel, materials and tools duri ng execution of the work. 40. Any work/material not specifically mentioned but reasonably required for proper completion and commissioning/readiness of the mounting provision shall be deemed included in the contractor's s cope. 41. The quoted rates shall be firm and inclusive of all labour, materials, consumables, transp ortation, loading/unloading, tools and tackles, fabrication, installation, painting, mobili zation/demobilization and all other incidental expenses, except statutory taxes/GST, which shall be indicated separately as applicable. 42. All other terms and conditions shall be as per GeM GTC. ANNEXURE-III UNDERTAKING The bidder has to provide an UNDERTAKING to be submitted along-with the bid: 1. Hereby certify that the fabricated items will be supplied as per technical specification & scope of w ork provided in the bidding document. 2. Hereby certify that all terms and conditions, as laid down in this bid are acceptable to us in toto. 3. Hereby undertake to provide all the necessary compliances / invoice / documents required under G ST legislation for enabling ONGC to avail Input tax (GST) credit. 4. Hereby undertake to not to vary/modify the bid during the validity period or any extension agreed t hereof. 5. Hereby undertake that that all the documents / certificates / information submitted by us against t he tender are genuine. .
